translation.en: The wrongdoer was punished.
The judge punished the wrongdoer.
The poor man complained about the wrongdoer.
The wrongdoer's injustice ended.
The pious sat in the mosque.
The grandfather visited the pious.
I sat with the pious.
The houses of the pious are clean.
Grandfather's sight is weak.
The doctor examined the eyesight.
The doctor spoke about eyesight.
Strength of sight is important.
The word is difficult.
The child wrote a word.
The poet thought about the word.
The explanation of the word is easy.
Humans learn.
The scholar loves humans.
The dog lives with humans.
Human nature varies.
The livestock eat in the valley.
The farmer drives the livestock.
The farmer went out with the livestock.
The owner of the livestock is rich.
The man's descendants are many.
The grandfather left many descendants.
The grandfather was glad about his offspring.
The future of the offspring is important.
The wind is cold.
The child heard the wind.
The leaves fly with the wind.
The sound of the wind is strong.
The door opened.
The guard closed the door.
The cat went out through the door.
The colour of the door is white.
The group is small.
The guide accompanied a group of tourists.
I traveled with a group of students.
The opinion of the group is clear.
The deniers do not believe the news.
The scientist did not convince the deniers.
The scientist spoke with the deniers.
The deniers' argument is weak.
The reward is large.
The child waited for the reward.
The child was glad about the reward.
The value of the reward is large.
The winter night is long.
The grandfather remembered the first night.

translation.bs: Mjesec je izašao u vedroj noći.
translation.en: The moon came out on a clear night.
The end of the night is quiet.
Repentance changes the human being.
The child showed repentance.

translation.bs: Otac se obradovao pokajanju svoga sina.
translation.en: The father was glad about his son's repentance.
The sincerity of the repentance is clear.
The rope is long.
The sailor ties the rope.
The farmer pulled the cow with the rope.
The color of the rope is yellow.
Luck helped the team.

translation.bs: Majka je poželjela sreću svojoj kćerki.
translation.en: The mother wished luck for her daughter.
The player relied on luck.
The role of luck is small.
A greeting arrived from the grandfather.
The child returned the greeting.
The teacher received the students with a greeting.
The word of greeting is short.
The invitation made the grandmother happy.
The neighbor accepted the invitation.

translation.bs: Gost je zahvalio komšiji na pozivu.
translation.en: The guest thanked the neighbor for the invitation.
The text of the invitation is short.
The writer is famous.
The journalist asked the writer.
The readers spoke with the writer.
The writer's pen is old.
The waves are high today.
The travelers heard the waves.

translation.bs: Djeca su se igrala u valovima.
translation.en: The children played in the waves.
The sound of the waves is calm.
Hatred spoils hearts.
The father rejected hatred.
The teacher warned of hatred.
The result of hatred is bad.
The player's leg is broken.
The doctor treated the leg.

translation.bs: Igrač je osjetio bol u nozi.
translation.en: The player felt pain in the leg.
The pain in the leg is severe.
The road was long.
The children crossed the road.
The car stopped in the road.
The end of the road is near.
Chins are different.
The artist sketched the chins.
The doctor looked at the chins.
The form of the chins is different.
The pegs are strong.

translation.bs: Otac je učvrstio klinove u zemlji.
translation.en: The father fixed the pegs in the ground.
The father ties the ropes to the pegs.
The number of the pegs is ten.

translation.bs: Družina ljudi je ušla u selo.
translation.en: A group of men entered the village.
The children saw a group of travelers.
The man traveled with the group.
The leader of the group is brave.

translation.bs: Stara mjesta su brojna u gradu.
translation.en: The old places are many in the city.
The tourists visited the old places.

translation.bs: Djeca su tražila na mračnim mjestima.
translation.en: The children searched in the dark places.
The names of the places are written.
The thread is very long.
The mother cut the thread.

translation.bs: Nana je sašila odjeću bijelim koncem.
translation.en: The grandmother sewed the garment with a white thread.
The thread's color is blue.
The mirage appeared in the desert.
The traveler saw a mirage.
The guide spoke about the mirage.
The image of the mirage deceives the eye.
Prosperity does not last.
People love prosperity.
The family lived in prosperity.
The days of prosperity are short.
The torrent demolished the bridge.
The farmer saw the torrent.
The people fled from the torrent.

translation.bs: Djeca su se bojala snage bujice.
translation.en: The children were afraid of the strength of the torrent.
A handful of wheat suffices for the chickens.
The child took a handful of sand.
The poor man was content with a handful of dates.
The price of a handful of wheat is little.
The attire for the holiday is beautiful.

translation.bs: Otac je kupio ruho svojoj djeci.
translation.en: The father purchased the attire for his children.

translation.bs: Djeca su se obradovala novom ruhu.
translation.en: The children were happy about the new attire.
The grandfather paid the price of the attire.
